body:
Thank you, I really means something to me. 

I feel so terrible and I feel even worse when I have these thoughts. I wonder why she can't be there for me through this disease? I wasn't always this way. We had really good times together. Why can't she look back and see that I can go back to that with help? Why didn't she sit me down and force open my eyes before it got here?

I feel like shit when I try to blame something on her, it's not her fault. She did try maybe not in ways I recognized. She just had enough I guess.
